parameter.name: oidc_account_id_claims
parameter.description:
A comma-separated, ordered list of OIDC userinfo claim names to use as the Linux account name for generic OIDC providers.
When this option is set, Himmelblau tries each named claim in order and uses the first claim that is present as a non-empty string. The claim names are not limited to standard OpenID Connect claims; provider-specific userinfo claims may also be listed.
If none of the configured claims match a non-empty string claim in userinfo, Himmelblau logs a warning and falls back to the default account-name selection: .B preferred_username first, then .B email.
parameter.conf_description: Ordered OIDC userinfo claims used for Linux account names.
